aiAnalysis.notes: Nested text styling required. 'My' is Gray (#A9A9A9), 'Profile' is Orange (#FF9A6D). LineHeight 64px.
Chart container. Flex-row, alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 16. Contains alternating vertical lines (dividers) and column stacks (bars).
Vertical Grid Line. Width 0 in Figma -> Use width: 1 or StyleSheet.hairlineWidth in RN. Height 100% (or fixed 161).
Chart Column (JAN). Flex-column, justifyContent: 'flex-end', alignItems: 'center', gap: 9. MUST have overflow:visible for the bubble to extend horizontally.
Status Bubble ('on time'). Width (58px) > Parent Column (24px). Sits at top of flex stack.
Secured Account Section. Vertical stack, gap: 4. Contains two separate touchable cards with borderRadius: 12.
Payment Info Card. Background #202020, borderRadius 12. Vertical stack with gap: 8. Children are transparent rows and 1px dividers.
